reims.note: Modern graphics baseline; nested QEMU submodule.

reims-qemu.note: Pinned submodule; not interchangeable with portable fork.

metal2vulkan.note: Resolve only when needed, pinned by Reims manifest.

qemu-portable.note: TCG-capable VMApple fork; used for the GPU-less VMApple control (patch 0001) and the ARM virt diagnostic build. Its legacy Reims Cargo glue is not used (docs/reports/INTEGRATION_NOTES.md).

validation: Pinned upstream checkouts verified by tools/fetch-sources.sh and tools/check-research-patches.py. Current status and milestones: docs/STATUS.md and docs/RESULTS.md.

active_integration.role: Active mainline VMApple + TCG + Reims ARM 16 KiB integration
